dungeons_iso.binds.lockOn: Hold to disable locking on to enemy position
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dungeons_: Changes Minecraft's perspective to be more like Minecraft Dungeons.
dungeons_iso.config.title: §6Dungeons Perspective
dungeons_iso.config.fogOfWar.name: Fog of War
dungeons_iso.config.fogOfWar.description: While enabled, things you shouldn't be able to see will be obscured by a fog of war.
dungeons_iso.config.distanceFog.name: Distance Fog
dungeons_iso.config.distanceFog.descript: Pushes a distance fog band out with the isometric zoom to hide distant rendering artifacts. Disable to see farther, at the cost of visible far-chunk glitches.
dungeons_iso.config.renderDistanceCap.de: Caps Sodium's render distance to a zoom-based radius while the perspective is active, instead of using your full video-settings render distance. Disable to render chunks out to your normal render distance.
dungeons_iso.config.cullangle.name: Cull Radius
dungeons_iso.config.cullangle.descriptio: Increase or decrease the radius of the culling cylinder.
dungeons_iso.config.coneHalfAngle.name: Cone Half-Angle
dungeons_iso.config.coneHalfAngle.descri: The half-angle of the cone near the player that tapers the culling area. Lower values create a narrower cone, reducing culling of nearby blocks.
dungeons_iso.config.xiv.name: XIV Mode
dungeons_iso.config.xiv.description: While enabled, dragging the mouse up and down while holding Move Camera adjusts the Pitch instead of the Zoom.
dungeons_iso.config.scrollWheelZoom.name: Scroll Wheel Zoom
dungeons_iso.config.scrollWheelZoom.desc: Zoom with scroll wheel (overrides hotbar scrolling).
dungeons_iso.config.bias.name: Sound Listener Bias
dungeons_iso.config.bias.description: How close the camera is to the player for the purpose of sound.
dungeons_iso.config.cameraRelative.name: Camera-relative Movement
dungeons_iso.config.cameraRelative.descr: Make movement work relative to the camera instead of the player. (Recommended with Turn to Mouse On, when Off)
dungeons_iso.config.joystickMovement.des: Drive movement with a connected controller's left analog stick. The stick moves the character relative to the camera (like WASD) and, while pushed past the deadzone, overrides the keyboard. Always on in Controller Mode.
dungeons_iso.config.lockOnTargeting.name: Lock-on Targeting
dungeons_iso.config.lockOnTargeting.desc: Cycle through mobs with a keybind. Locked-on mobs override cursor targeting.
Toggles if this feature is allowed on the server.
dungeons_iso.config.capabilities:
Additional features that aren't vanilla server friendly.
§eThese must be allowed by the server operator. On local worlds, commands must be enabled.
dungeons_iso.config.targetFromCamera.des: Pick target from cursor position, bypassing player line of sight.
dungeons_iso.config.unlimitedReach.name: Unlimited Reach
dungeons_iso.config.unlimitedReach.descr: Allow interaction with blocks no matter how far from the player they are.
dungeons_iso.config.dynamic_camera.name: Context Based Smooth Camera
dungeons_iso.config.dynamic_camera.descr: Offsets the camera based on your current speed vector.
dungeons_iso.config.movefactor.name: Smooth Camera Move Factor
dungeons_iso.config.movefactor.descripti: Subtly changes motion of smooth camera.
dungeons_iso.config.fov.name: Default FOV
dungeons_iso.config.fov.description: FOV that the game starts in.
dungeons_iso.config.force_no_defer.name: Force Never Deferring Chunks
dungeons_iso.config.force_no_defer.descr: Might help to turn off if you are experiencing lag. Turn Always Chunk Deferring on in Sodium as well if you turn this off.
dungeons_iso.config.click_to_move.name: Click To Move (Not working on Neoforge)
dungeons_iso.config.click_to_move.descri: Turn on to experience the mod in Click To Move mode.
dungeons_iso.config.turn_to_mouse.name: Always Rotate Towards Mouse
dungeons_iso.config.turn_to_mouse.descri: Turn on always be rotated towards the mouse when not on a mount. Otherwise, you sometimes move towards your movement.
dungeons_iso.config.force.name: Force Perspective
dungeons_iso.config.force.description: Force the perspective to always be on.
dungeons_iso.config.onStartup.name: Force on Startup
dungeons_iso.config.onStartup.descriptio: Turn the perspective on upon first loading into a world in your session.
dungeons_iso.config.forceAutoJump.name: Force AutoJump in Click To Move
dungeons_iso.config.forceAutoJump.descri: Force Auto-Jump in Click To Move.
dungeons_iso.config.zoomFactor.name: Zoom and FOV Factor
dungeons_iso.config.rollTowardsCursor.de: When enabled, you will roll towards the cursor rather than in the direction you're moving.
dungeons_iso.config.additionalMeleeAssis: Look at clicked target for 1 second after click
When enabled, you will snap towards targets you click for 1 second after the click. Helps with melee.
When enabled, your character automatically faces the enemy under (or near) the cursor while attacking, aiming, or casting. Melee/ranged/casting choose the target; ground-aimed spells still place manually when the cursor is on empty ground.
dungeons_iso.config.movementTargeting.de: (Requires Contextual Combat Targeting) Uses your movement direction instead of the cursor to acquire combat targets. Built for controller, one-handed, and keyboard-only play. Once a target is chosen it persists while you strafe or retreat (kiting); moving decisively toward another enemy switches after a short confirmation.
dungeons_iso.config.contextualInteract.d: When enabled, the nearest usable block (chest, door, furnace, button, etc.) near your cursor or movement direction is highlighted; press the Interact key to use it. Uses the same pointer/movement input mode as combat targeting. Does not replace right-click or click-to-move.
dungeons_iso.config.controllerMode.name: Controller Mode
dungeons_iso.config.controllerMode.descr: Master preset for controller / one-handed / no-mouse play. While enabled it overrides these settings (your saved values are restored when you turn it off): Turn Towards Mouse OFF, Contextual Combat Targeting ON, Movement-Based Targeting ON, Contextual Block Interaction ON, Click to Move OFF, and Combat Roll 'Roll Towards Cursor' OFF.
dungeons_iso.config.clipToSpace.name: Additional Zoom Effects
dungeons_iso.config.clipToSpace.descript: Additonal Automatic Zoom in and out depending on certain events.
dungeons_iso.config.ortho.name: Orthographic Mode
dungeons_iso.config.ortho.description: Makes all blocks the same size regardless of distance. RTS-Like.
dungeons_iso.config.frustumCulling.name: Frustum Culling
dungeons_iso.config.frustumCulling.descr: Adds a frustum shape that culls blocks before it, making traversing through caves easier. Improves performance, but can be distracting. May make buildings look weird.
dungeons_iso.config.zNearFactor.name: Z-Near Factor
dungeons_iso.config.zNearFactor.descript: Adjusts the camera's near-clipping plane to determine how close objects must be to the isometric camera before they are hidden.
dungeons_iso.config.showFirstTimeGui.des: When enabled, shows a prompt the first time you join a world asking whether to enable or disable the top-down perspective on login. Re-enabling this resets your previous choice.
dungeons_iso.firsttime.title: §6Dungeons Perspective
dungeons_iso.firsttime.description: Would you like to enable the top-down perspective when joining worlds? You can change this later.
dungeons_iso.config.roomCulling.name: Room roof culling
dungeons_iso.config.roomCulling.descript: Detects the enclosed space you are standing in and removes its ceiling, including the walls and pillars that ceiling rests on.
dungeons_iso.config.roomRadius.name: Room radius
dungeons_iso.config.roomRadius.descripti: Maximum horizontal reach of the room flood, in blocks. Walls normally stop it well before this; it is a safety cap, not the boundary.
dungeons_iso.config.roomWallThickness.de: How far the room footprint grows outward to swallow the surrounding walls. Too low and the roof above the walls survives as a rim.
dungeons_iso.config.roomMaxVolume.name: Max room volume
dungeons_iso.config.roomMaxVolume.descri: Cells visited before the space is judged a cave system rather than a room.
Chunk sections re-meshed per tick, shared by both cullers. The one setting that directly trades responsiveness for frame time.
dungeons_iso.config.roomNodesPerSlice.de: Cells the scanner visits before yielding. Lower spreads a scan over more ticks.
dungeons_iso.config.roomRescanCooldown.d: Minimum ticks between room scans, on top of requiring you to have changed block.
dungeons_iso.config.shapeCulling.name: Shape culling
dungeons_iso.config.shapeCulling.descrip: Removes whole connected shapes standing between the camera and you, nearest first. Replaces the old cylinder entirely.
dungeons_iso.config.terrainOccludeThresh: Fraction of sample rays a shape must block before it counts as hiding you. Raise to keep more standing, lower to cull more.
dungeons_iso.config.sightlineSuppressThr: Above this fraction of unobstructed rays, nothing is culled at all.
dungeons_iso.config.terrainShapeCap.name: Shape size cap
dungeons_iso.config.terrainShapeCap.desc: Blocks per shape before it is judged unresolved and skipped. Terrain connects to the horizon and will always exceed this, which is how hillsides are left alone.
dungeons_iso.config.sightlineMaxCulledBl: Most blocks removed at once, across all shapes.
Camera movement, in blocks, that forces a fresh cast before the cooldown elapses.
dungeons_iso.config.terrainSilhouetteCul: Whether natural ground can start a silhouette opening. Turn off to leave hillsides and cliffs untouched and remove only trees and built structures. This gates what may start an opening, not what it grows through — once open it spreads through any block type, so nothing is left hanging in the middle of a hole.
dungeons_iso.config.terrainSilhouetteDil: How far the terrain opening grows beyond the blocks directly in the way, in blocks. 0 leaves a per-ray speckle; 2 gives the opening some thickness.
dungeons_iso.config.roomCeilingTolerance: How far below your own ceiling height the room flood may still go, in blocks. A doorway lintel sits below the ceiling, so a low value stops the flood at the threshold instead of spilling into the next room and taking its roof off. Raise for stepped or vaulted ceilings; lower if adjacent rooms are still included.
dungeons_iso.config.ghostCulledBlocks.de: Draw removed blocks back as translucent geometry instead of leaving a void. Opacity rises with distance from you, so the world still reads as intact and only the pocket around you is see-through.
dungeons_iso.config.ghostMaxAlpha.name: Ghost maximum opacity
dungeons_iso.config.ghostMaxAlpha.descri: Opacity the ghost tops out at. Below 1 it always reads as ghosted rather than solid.
dungeons_iso.config.ghostClearScreen.des: Radius around you that stays completely clear, measured on screen. 1.0 is the distance from you to the top edge of the window, so 0.2 is a fifth of the way there. Screen distance rather than world distance, so the pocket stays circular however the camera is angled.
dungeons_iso.config.ghostOpaqueScreen.de: Screen distance at which the ghost reaches full opacity, in the same units — 1.0 is the top edge of the window. The gradient runs from the clear radius out to here.
dungeons_iso.config.treeLeafSpread.name: Canopy reach from trunk
dungeons_iso.config.treeLeafSpread.descr: How many blocks of leaves may separate a canopy block from its nearest log. This keeps one tree from becoming a forest: neighbouring canopies touch, so without it a single flood walks tree to tree until it is discarded as unresolved. Raise for unusually broad canopies; lower if adjacent trees are still taken together.
dungeons_iso.config.treeShapeCap.name: Tree size cap
dungeons_iso.config.treeShapeCap.descrip: Blocks per tree shape before it is judged unresolved and skipped. Canopies are large and interlocking ones merge, so trees need far more headroom than built structures.
dungeons_iso.config.shapeMaxSpan.name: Shape max width
dungeons_iso.config.shapeMaxSpan.descrip: Widest a shape may get horizontally before it is judged unresolved and skipped. This is the limit that separates a tree from a forest: trees are tall and narrow, while a canopy sprawling from tree to tree is wide and flat and trips this long before the height limit.
dungeons_iso.config.shapeMaxHeight.name: Shape max height
dungeons_iso.config.shapeMaxHeight.descr: Tallest a shape may get before it is judged unresolved. Generous by default so large jungle trees, which run about thirty blocks, still resolve whole.
dungeons_iso.config.unifiedSilhouette.de: Cut a silhouette-shaped opening through whatever is in the way, rather than detecting and removing whole objects. On by default: a silhouette always resolves, while deciding where one tree ends has no reliable answer once canopies touch. Ghosting removed blocks back translucently means the opening reads as the tree going see-through rather than as damage. Turn off to go back to object detection.
dungeons_iso.config.roomCoverHeight.name: Cover removal height
dungeons_iso.config.roomCoverHeight.desc: How far above the room ceiling to keep removing, in blocks. This is what lets you see into the ground floor of a building: the walk crosses the air between storeys instead of stopping at the first solid layer, so the upper floor and the roof above it come away together. Only solid blocks in that span cost anything. Lower it if a room buried under deep terrain removes more hillside than you want.
dungeons_iso.config.disableOcclusionCull: Turns off Sodium occlusion culling whenever blocks are being removed. Off by default and best left off: with it on, every section in view is drawn with no visibility graph, which in a large modpack costs far more than the culling itself. Turn on only if you see missing terrain through a culled opening.
dungeons_iso.config.cullDebugLog.name: Log culling state
dungeons_iso.config.cullDebugLog.descrip: Writes a line of culling diagnostics to the log once a second. For troubleshooting only. The keybind report is unaffected and always available.
dungeons_iso.config.requires_yacl: Dungeons Perspective settings need YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) installed. Everything else works without it.
